about: Who keeps each service (#9895). A town draws one person per service from its list by its stable identity. A portrait is a path (a still) or {rest, talk}: animated PNG loops at one texel per pixel, the talking loop shown while a new line is said (#10027, made with the parts-rig route in art/people/README.md). A person without one shows no portrait. A figure is the keeper standing at their door in the town view: a rig-c parts rig the Engine poses at runtime, its looping clip, metres per rig unit and texel (rig units per texel); the kit piece's keeper spot is where they stand.
